faq.title: FAQ
faq.intro: Quick answers about Geeklogs. For account or billing help, contact support.
faq.q1Body: A single place to log movies, TV, games, board games, books, anime, manga, and comics—with grades, reviews, and stats.
faq.q2Body: Some catalogs (e.g. TMDB, RAWG, BGG) work best with your own free API keys. Add them in Settings, or use server defaults when available. Admins can relax key requirements for everyone via feature flags.
faq.q3Title: What is the difference between Free, Beta, and Pro?
faq.q3Body: Free has a log limit and core features. Beta usually includes Pro-style features with the same log cap as Free. Pro removes the log limit and includes full access. See Plans for current details.
faq.q4Title: How do I export my data?
faq.q4Body: Pro (and Beta where enabled) can export logs from category views and Settings. Exports are generated from your account data on the server.
faq.q5Title: How do I delete my account?
faq.q5Body: Contact {{email}} with your registered email address. We will verify ownership and process deletion according to our retention policy.

legal.privacyS1Body:
Geeklogs (“Geeklogs,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) operates the Geeklogs website, application programming interface (API), and related mobile or desktop clients made available by us (collectively, the “Service”). This Privacy Policy (“Policy”) describes how we collect, use, disclose, store, and otherwise process information that identifies or relates to you (“Personal Data”) when you access or use the Service, and explains certain choices you may have.

This Policy is intended to be read together with our Terms of Service. Capitalized terms used but not defined here have the meanings given in the Terms unless the context requires otherwise.

IMPORTANT: This Policy is provided for transparency and operational purposes only. It does not create rights enforceable by third parties, does not constitute legal advice, and does not form an attorney–client relationship. Laws vary by jurisdiction; you should retain qualified legal counsel to advise on compliance obligations applicable to your situation.
legal.privacyS2Body:
We collect Personal Data in the categories below, depending on how you use the Service:

(a) Account and profile information. When you register or maintain an account, we process identifiers and credentials such as your email address, a hashed password, and, if you provide one, a username. We may also process preferences you set (for example, display theme, language or locale, visible media categories, board-game catalog provider selection, recap email preferences, and similar settings), subscription tier, onboarding status, and profile-related selections you make (such as badges shown on a public profile, where available).

(b) Content and activity you submit. The core function of the Service is to record your media-related activity. Accordingly, we process content and metadata you submit, which may include titles, identifiers from third-party catalogs, ratings or grades, free-text reviews, status or progress fields (for example, seasons, episodes, chapters, volumes, hours-to-beat, matches played), collection-related flags (such as ownership or “want to buy”), optional purchase or spending amounts and associated currency codes where you choose to provide them, timestamps, and similar log or review data. We also process social or engagement data you generate where the Service supports it (for example, reactions to others’ reviews, follow relationships between accounts, and any optional public-facing profile elements you enable).

(c) Payment and subscription data. If you purchase a paid subscription (for example, “Pro”), payment processing is handled by our payment processor, Stripe, Inc. and its affiliates (“Stripe”). We do not receive or store your full payment card number on our systems. We receive and retain identifiers and transactional metadata necessary to administer your subscription (for example, Stripe customer and subscription identifiers, billing period, subscription status, and country or region information used to determine pricing or tax treatment where applicable).

(d) Technical, usage, and diagnostic data. We automatically collect certain technical data when you interact with the Service, which may include IP address, device or browser type, general location derived from IP, request timestamps, referring URLs, and similar server and application logs. Where enabled, we use error and performance monitoring tools (for example, Sentry) that may receive error reports, stack traces, and related diagnostic information. We may also record limited product-analytics events on our servers (for example, feature usage counters) in support of reliability, security, and product improvement.

(e) Communications. If you contact us (including at {{email}}), we process the contents of your message and associated metadata (such as sender address and time sent) to respond and to maintain records as permitted by law.

(f) Optional third-party API credentials. Certain features allow you to store, at your election, API keys, tokens, or similar credentials for third-party data sources (for example, The Movie Database (TMDB), RAWG, BoardGameGeek, Ludopedia, Comic Vine, or other providers we may support). Those credentials are stored in association with your account and used solely to retrieve catalog or metadata on your behalf when you use the relevant features. You are responsible for complying with each provider’s terms and for the security of keys you submit.
legal.privacyS3Title: 3. Purposes of Processing; Legal Bases (EEA, UK, and Similar Jurisdictions)
legal.privacyS4Title: 4. Cookies, Local Storage, and Similar Technologies
legal.privacyS4Body:
We and our service providers use cookies, local storage, session tokens, and similar technologies as needed to operate the Service. For example, we may set HTTP-only authentication cookies or equivalent mechanisms so that you can remain signed in, and we may store preferences (such as theme or locale) in your browser’s local storage or comparable facilities on native clients.

If we integrate third-party advertising (for example, Google AdSense or similar programs), those providers may use cookies or similar technologies to measure delivery and personalize or limit ads according to their policies. Where required by law, we will obtain consent before using non-essential advertising cookies or similar tracking technologies. You may control certain cookies through your browser settings; disabling required cookies may impair authentication or core functionality.
legal.privacyS5Body:
We disclose Personal Data only as described in this Policy or at the time of collection:

• Service providers and subprocessors. We engage vendors to perform functions on our behalf, such as cloud hosting, database services, payment processing (Stripe), transactional or operational email delivery, error monitoring (for example, Sentry), and infrastructure security. These parties may access Personal Data solely to perform services for us and are contractually or legally obligated to protect it, subject to their own policies where they act as independent controllers for limited purposes.

• Advertising partners. If advertising integrations are enabled, ad networks may collect or receive information as described in their policies and, where applicable, through cookies or similar technologies.

• Legal and safety. We may disclose information if we believe in good faith that disclosure is required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request; to enforce our Terms or policies; to investigate potential violations; or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Geeklogs, our users, or the public.

• Business transfers. If we are involved in a merger, acquisition, financing, reorganization, bankruptcy, or sale of assets, Personal Data may be transferred as part of that transaction, subject to safeguards required by law.

We do not sell your Personal Data for monetary consideration as that term is commonly understood in general privacy statutes. We do not share Personal Data with third parties for their independent marketing purposes except as stated here or with your direction or consent where required.
legal.privacyS6Body: The Service may retrieve descriptive metadata, artwork, or related content from third-party databases and APIs. Those third parties process information under their own terms and privacy policies. Your decision to supply optional API credentials to Geeklogs does not make us responsible for third-party services’ availability, accuracy, or practices. The Service may also contain links to third-party websites; we are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.
legal.privacyS7Body:
We retain Personal Data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, including providing the Service, complying with legal, tax, accounting, or reporting requirements, resolving disputes, and enforcing agreements. Retention periods may vary depending on data category and legal obligations.

We implement administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect Personal Data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure; you use the Service at your own risk to that extent.

If you access the Service from outside the country where our servers or subprocessors are located, your information may be transferred to, stored in, or processed in other countries, including the United States or other jurisdictions that may not provide the same level of data protection as your home jurisdiction. Where required, we implement appropriate safeguards (such as standard contractual clauses) or rely on derogations permitted by law.
legal.privacyS8Body:
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, or object to certain processing of your Personal Data, and in some cases the right to data portability. You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. To exercise rights, or to ask questions about this Policy, contact us at {{email}}. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling certain requests.

If you are a resident of California, Colorado, Virginia, or other U.S. states with comprehensive privacy laws, you may have additional rights (such as to know categories of Personal Data collected, to request deletion subject to exceptions, and to opt out of certain “sale” or “sharing” as defined by statute). As stated above, we do not sell Personal Data for money in the conventional sense; where definitions of “sale” or “sharing” capture specific disclosures (for example, certain advertising technology), you may contact {{email}} to exercise applicable opt-out rights where available.

Marketing and recap emails: where we send optional communications, we will provide a mechanism to unsubscribe or adjust preferences as required by law.
legal.privacyS9Body: The Service is not directed to individuals under the age of 16 (or the minimum age required in your jurisdiction to consent to data processing without parental authorization). We do not knowingly collect Personal Data from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child, contact us at {{email}} and we will take appropriate steps to delete it, subject to law.
legal.privacyS10Body:
We may modify this Policy from time to time. We will post the updated Policy on the Service and revise the “Last updated” date above. Where required by law or where changes are material, we will provide additional notice (for example, by email or in-product message). Your continued use of the Service after the effective date of changes constitutes your acknowledgment of the updated Policy, except where prohibited by law.

For any privacy-related requests or inquiries, contact: {{email}}.
legal.termsIntro: By using Geeklogs you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service. We may update these terms; continued use after changes means you accept the new terms.

apiKeyTutorial.tmdb:
1. Go to themoviedb.org and create a free account or log in.
2. Open Settings → API from the left menu (or go to the link below).
3. Click "Request an API Key" and choose "Developer".
4. Accept the terms and fill the form (Application URL: your site or http://localhost:5173, Application Summary: e.g. "Personal media log").
5. On the API page, copy the "API Key (v3 auth)" and paste it below.
apiKeyTutorial.rawg:
1. Go to rawg.io and sign up or log in.
2. Open the API docs link below and look for "Get your API key" or the signup form.
3. Register for an API key (free tier available).
4. Copy the key from your account/dashboard and paste it below.
apiKeyTutorial.bgg:
1. Go to boardgamegeek.com and log in (or create an account).
2. Open the Applications link below.
3. Click to create a new application (e.g. "Geeklogs").
4. Choose non-commercial if it's for personal use; submit and wait for approval (can take a few days).
5. Once approved, open your application and create a Token.
6. Copy the Bearer token and paste it below.
apiKeyTutorial.ludopedia:
1. Create an account at https://ludopedia.com.br/novousuario or log in at ludopedia.com.br.
2. Open Aplicativos (https://www.ludopedia.com.br/aplicativos) and create an application.
3. Use Ludopedia's OAuth flow to obtain an access token (see API documentation). The key required for Ominilog is the Access Token (ACCESS_TOKEN).
4. The token is valid for 60 days; paste it below.
apiKeyTutorial.comicvine:
1. Go to comicvine.gamespot.com and create a free account or log in.
2. Open the API documentation link below.
3. Request an API key (free) from the Comic Vine API page.
4. Copy your API key and paste it below.

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.betaModalMessage:
Thank you for being a beta tester—you're among the first people using Geeklogs, and your activity and feedback genuinely help us improve the product.

As a thank-you, your beta account gets full access to every Pro feature at no cost, forever. You won't need a subscription for those perks while you're on the beta tier.

We're still moving fast: things may change and you might hit the occasional rough edge. If you spot a bug or have a suggestion, we'd love to hear from you. Enjoy logging everything—and thanks again for being here early.

batchEntry.fileHint: CSV or XLSX, max 100 rows and 1MB. Required: a title column (Name, Title, Filme, Jogo, etc.). Optional columns depend on the category below; headers are case-insensitive and many synonyms work.
batchEntry.exampleFormatIntro: Use a header row. The title column can be named Name, Title, Filme, Livro, Game, Anime, or similar. Status can be the English API value or the same label you see in the app in English, Português, or Español (e.g. “Assistido”, “Quero assistir”, “Visto”). Grade / rate is 0–10. Yes/No fields accept yes, no, true, false, 1, 0, sim, não, y, n. Money: use whole minor units (e.g. 2499 = $24.99) or a decimal major amount (24.99) — both work when a 3-letter currency column is set. Genres and mechanics: separate with commas, semicolons, | or /. Ownership can use one column with English phrases or the app’s labels in your language (e.g. Tenho, Quero comprar, Vendido, Não tenho).
batchEntry.exampleFormatNote: Each row is searched in the selected category; the first catalog match is used. Leave cells empty when a field does not apply. Re-import with “Override existing logs” to update grades, reviews, progress fields, and collection data.

about.title: About
about.projectBody: Geeklogs is a single place to log movies, TV, board games, video games, books, anime, manga, and comics. Look up titles from well-known catalogs, track status and progress, save reviews and grades, and explore your history through stats, a calendar, spending summaries when you choose to track them, and board-game play sessions. Add custom rows when something is not in the catalog, follow friends' activity, and use optional API keys for faster search. Pro unlocks CSV exports and deeper statistics.
about.projectHostingNote: The service runs on modest hosting; the first request after idle can take a few seconds while things wake up. We keep shipping improvements—thanks for sticking with us.
about.donationIntro: If Geeklogs is useful to you, you can support its development with a one-time donation or recurring support. Thank you!
about.donationNotConfigured: Donation links are not configured. Set VITE_DONATION_KOFI_URL and/or VITE_DONATION_GITHUB_SPONSORS_URL in your deployment environment to show them here.
about.donatePixIntro: Support via Pix: scan the QR code with your banking app.

mobileAppBanner.iosHelpStep2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen
mobileAppBanner.iosHelpStep3: Tap Add in the top-right corner

coldStart.error: Geeklogs couldn’t finish loading. Check that you’re online, then tap Try again. If you haven’t opened the app in a while, it may need a little extra time the first time.
coldStart.serverSleepingHint: If nobody has used Geeklogs for a while, the first load can take up to a minute. We’re still trying in the background—you can also tap Try again whenever you like.
coldStart.timedOut: We’ve waited as long as we can and Geeklogs still isn’t responding. Check your internet connection and tap Try again. If you use a free hosting plan, waking the app up can take a full minute.
coldStart.code_TIMEOUT: Geeklogs is taking much longer than usual to answer—this often happens right after it hasn’t been used for a while. Check Wi‑Fi or mobile data, wait a bit, then tap Try again.
coldStart.code_NETWORK: We couldn’t reach Geeklogs. Make sure you’re connected to the internet, then try again.
coldStart.code_SERVER_ERROR: Geeklogs ran into a problem while working on your request. Please try again in a few minutes.
coldStart.code_UNAUTHORIZED: Your sign-in has expired or isn’t valid anymore. Sign in again to keep using your lists and reviews.
coldStart.code_FORBIDDEN: You don’t have access to that. If that surprises you, sign out and sign back in, or contact support.
coldStart.code_NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find what you were looking for. It may have been removed, or the link might be old.
coldStart.code_CLIENT_ERROR: We couldn’t make sense of that action. Double-check what you entered and try again.
coldStart.code_VERSION_MISMATCH: Something went wrong while loading. Tap Try again, or install the latest update from your app store if one is available.
coldStart.code_UNKNOWN: Something unexpected went wrong while loading. Tap Try again. If it keeps happening, close the app completely and open it again, or install the latest update.

errorBoundary.title: This part of Geeklogs couldn’t load
errorBoundary.message: Your saved items are usually fine—this is just one screen that hit a snag. Tap Try again to reload it.

errorCodes.docsIntro: When something goes wrong, you'll see a short message and a code (e.g. E001). Use this list to look up what each code means.

toast.E009: Select at least one category to export
toast.E011: You've reached the 500-log limit on the Free plan. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited logs.
toast.E022: Please enter a valid image URL
toast.E024: Could not send feedback. Try again later.
toast.E025: Could not start checkout. Try again later.
toast.E026: Could not resume subscription. Try again later.

docs.E001: Shown when you try to sign in or register without entering email and password.
docs.E002: Sign-in request failed (e.g. wrong credentials or network).
docs.E003: Account creation failed (e.g. email already in use or network).
docs.E004: Password reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
docs.E005: Form validation failed (e.g. password too short or fields don't match).
docs.E006: API key field is empty. Enter a key from the provider.
docs.E007: You need to enter a key before saving (Settings → API Keys).
docs.E008: A save request failed (settings, API key, media types, or similar).
docs.E009: Export requires at least one category to be selected.
docs.E010: Export download failed (e.g. network or server).
docs.E011: Free plan limit of 500 logs reached. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited logs.
docs.E012: Saving your review failed (e.g. network or server).
docs.E013: Saving your log failed (e.g. network or server).
docs.E014: Deleting the log failed (e.g. network or server).
docs.E015: Sharing the image failed (e.g. share not supported or permission).
docs.E016: Search request failed (e.g. network or server).
docs.E017: A generic failure (e.g. copy link, follow, or network).
docs.E018: No search result was found for the given item name (batch import).
docs.E019: Loading the batch preview failed (e.g. network or server).
docs.E020: One or more rows in the batch import could not be added.
docs.E022: The image URL is not valid.
docs.E023: Canceling the subscription failed (e.g. payment provider).
docs.E024: Sending feedback failed (e.g. network or server).
docs.E025: Starting checkout failed (e.g. payment provider or network).
docs.E026: Resuming the subscription failed (e.g. payment provider or network).
docs.E099: An unexpected error occurred. Try again or contact support if it persists.
